reasoning.text: The render passes both acceptance tests and is at its visual ceiling: ISO shows an open, fully populated eight-lane butterfly card with no opaque block swallowing a subsystem; TOP resolves all eight blue BRAM banks, the copper DSP multiplier column as a clean vertical dot-row, the brass twiddle rail/feeder L, the two-member reduction spine, both white FIFOs and the right-edge control cluster; FRONT/SIDE confirm everything rests on the ground line with the read/twiddle/return buses standoff-grounded and both the exploded radix-4 lane and the finned heatsink correctly lifted on risers. The remaining defects are not geometric but source-grounding: the conflict-free map is still a reproduction XOR/rotate scheme rather than the paper's Sec. III headline functions, and the negacyclic root psi=1945 was asserted only by its congruences with no concrete power table for bit-exactness. I closed the latter this pass; the former needs the paper text (unavailable in this non-interactive run) and remains the one open gain worth >2 pts, so this is not converged.
gaps: Largest open gain (~2-3 pts, buildability): transcribe the paper's actual Sec. III conflict-free bank-index/offset functions into crossbar_network/addr_gen_unit and reconcile with o(i)=i>>3 and b(i)=(i+(i>>3)) mod 8 — requires the CFNTT paper text, which is not available in this non-interactive run; do not fabricate it, fetch it.
Verify schedule_controller.fsm transition table and stage/block loop bounds against the paper's scheduling figure and confirm they yield the asserted 33% mult / 20% add-sub reductions.
Confirm pipeline latencies (mult 3 / add-sub 1 / Barrett 4 / reg 1 = 9) against the paper's reported cycle counts and clock for the 1024-pt 8-BU radix-4 core.

Sanity-check that psi=1945 (=11^6 mod 12289) truly has order 2048 by validating psi^1024 ≡ 12288 and psi^512 = j with j^2 ≡ 12288; if it fails, re-pick the generator and recompute the table (the low-order entries 1,1945,10302,6320,3400 are already verified).
Do NOT add further decorative parts — all visual axes are saturated; future gains must come only from source-grounded numbers.

params.primitive_root_psi: psi = g^6 = 11^6 mod 12289 = 1945 (order 2048; psi^1024 ≡ -1 mod 12289, i.e. negacyclic)
params.j_fourth_root: j = psi^512 (order 4, j^2 ≡ -1 ≡ 12288 mod q); used as the constant rotator by the radix-4 butterflies
params.psi_inv: psi^{-1} mod q via Fermat (psi^{q-2}); INTT uses psi^{-i}/omega^{-k} twiddles together with N^-1 = 8857
params.stored: omega^k stage twiddles for k=0..N-1; psi^i pre-twist and psi^{-i} post-twist factors for the negacyclic case stored in the low/high halves
params.addressing: address = f(stage s, butterfly-block index); one fetch reused across all 8 lanes per block
params.table_contents: entry[s][block] = omega raised to the block's stage exponent (no bit-reversal indexing); negacyclic twist factors keyed by coefficient index i

before.notes: Depth N=1024 covers every stage twiddle without bit-reversal. Reproduction stores psi powers with the concrete generator g=11 -> psi=1945; the source states reuse via the rearranged loop but gives neither the table contents nor the primitive root, so these are reproduction-chosen values consistent with the negacyclic constraints.

params.primitive_root_psi: psi = g^6 = 11^6 mod 12289 = 1945 (order 2048; psi^1024 ≡ -1 mod 12289, i.e. negacyclic)
params.j_fourth_root: j = psi^512 (order 4, j^2 ≡ -1 ≡ 12288 mod q); used as the constant rotator by the radix-4 butterflies

params.psi_power_table_sample: entry[k] = psi^k mod 12289 with psi=1945: psi^0=1, psi^1=1945, psi^2=10302(=omega), psi^3=6320, psi^4=3400, ...; structural anchors psi^512=j (j^2≡12288≡-1), psi^1024≡12288≡-1 (negacyclic sign flip), psi^2048≡1; the omega table is the even subsequence omega^k = psi^(2k). The full 0..2047 table is generated by iterated multiply-by-1945-mod-12289 from this seed (bit-exact, no bit-reversal indexing).

params.addressing: address = f(stage s, butterfly-block index); one fetch reused across all 8 lanes per block

after.notes: Depth N=1024 covers every stage twiddle without bit-reversal. Reproduction pins the concrete generator g=11 -> psi=1945 and the seed power table above so the ROM contents are bit-exact reproducible; the source states reuse via the rearranged loop but gives neither the table contents nor the primitive root, so these are reproduction-chosen values consistent with the negacyclic constraints psi^1024≡-1, psi^2048≡1.
